assigned_instance: p2-assigned and mkp1-known identify the same measurement; its synthetic loss outcome at event 10 precedes any prediction record.
declared_chronology: reconstructed_after_result for the known assigned result; source literature is background, not a prior record

criteria.reason: Maintains the known outcome's timing before all recorded predictions, marks both hypotheses as post-result explanations and denies retroactive prediction credit.

evidence.quote: mkp1-known과 동일 회차이며 event 10의 결과가 모든 예측 기록에 선행한다. 두 가설 모두 사후 설명으로 기록하고 조건별 결과 중첩과 해석 공백을 남겼다.
결과는 event 10에 이미 알려졌고 history는 빈 배열이다. 참조 문구를 결과 전 예측으로 소급하지 않는다.

criteria.reason: Explicitly prevents a new ID or paper date from converting the same disclosed measurement to a prospective prediction. Proposed follow-up remains a separate unperformed observation.

evidence.quote: p2-assigned와 mkp1-known은 같은 회차이므로 두 기록의 모든 해당 origin은 reconstructed_after_result다. 새 ID나 논문 출판일은 이를 사전 예측으로 바꾸지 않는다.

criteria.reason: Makes the loss compatible with an MKP1 contribution only under unverified perturbation and measurement controls. Does not establish necessity or an exclusive pathway, and preserves hB as a potentially coexisting explanation.

evidence.quote: 특이적이고 유효한 MKP1 교란이며 기저 상태·생존성·판독 범위가 보존되었다면 기여를 지지할 수 있다. 그 조건이 확인되지 않아 필요성이나 유일한 경로의 증거로 확정하지 않는다.
hA와 hB의 양립 결과가 겹쳐 현재의 소실만으로 둘을 가를 수 없다.

prior_record_assessment: Preserves supplied hypothesis wording while refusing to backdate it into an absent prediction artifact. Does not substitute the publication for the empty history.
source_and_causal_assessment: Keeps the synthetic mediator outcome distinct from reported drug responses. Preserves the 1-hour MKP1 versus 24-hour p38 context, the uncertain relation between assay populations, and cofactor/promoter counterevidence. Does not turn a chronology label into measurement validity or mediator proof.
review_scope_limit: Structured response assessed against scientific P2 requirements; no schema, dispatch, runtime-read or clinical-validity certification.
